definitions.explanation: Clothing that is manufactured in standard sizes and sold in stores, as opposed to garments made to order or custom-tailored.

examples.japanese: {既製服|きせいふく}を{買|か}う。
この{店|みせ}は{既製服|きせいふく}しか{扱|あつか}っていない。
examples.english: This store only carries ready-made clothing.

examples.japanese: {既製服|きせいふく}だと{自分|じぶん}の{体|からだ}にぴったり{合|あ}わないことがある。
examples.english: With ready-made clothing, it sometimes doesn't fit your body perfectly.

notes:
A compound of {既製|きせい} (ready-made, prefabricated) and {服|ふく} (clothing). Refers to mass-produced clothing sold in standard sizes, contrasted with custom-tailored garments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {既製服|きせいふく}を{買|か}う — to buy ready-made clothes
- {既製服|きせいふく}のサイズ — ready-made clothing size
- {既製服|きせいふく}メーカー — ready-made clothing manufacturer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {注文服|ちゅうもんふく} — custom-made clothing; made to order
- {仕立|した}て — tailoring; custom sewing
- {既製品|きせいひん} — ready-made products (broader term, not limited to clothing)
